name: Generate Parcellation (Volume) from ROIs
summary: Combines a directory of binary NIfTI ROIs into a single volumetric parcellation (one label per ROI) with key.txt and label.json, using AFNI 3dTcat and 3dTstat.
description: Utility that stacks every ROI in the input rois directory and assigns each voxel the index of the ROI it belongs to (argmax), producing a parcellation/volume dataset and a label file naming each ROI. Use it to turn ROIs from other Apps into a parcellation for network or tract analysis. All ROIs must share the same voxel grid; where ROIs overlap a voxel gets a single label.

inputs.description: Directory of binary NIfTI ROIs (*.nii.gz) on the same voxel grid.

outputs.description: Volumetric parcellation (parc.nii.gz) with one integer label per input ROI, plus key.txt and label.json naming each label.
